verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's CLI docs say it can create and manage ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services and run local Postgres instances, which suggests real Postgres engines alongside ClickHouse. These are only one-line mentions, though, and the core ClickHouse engine is described by a user as having 'not-quite-standard SQL syntax'. missing for 10: confirmation that the Postgres services are the genuine engine with extension support, any MySQL or SQLite engine compatibility, documented details on dialect fidelity, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get real engine compatibility — the Postgres, MySQL, or SQLite dialect and extensions my existing code expects — not a lookalike subset
